description: This file defines a reflection utility package 'reflect2' providing advanced type introspection and manipulation features, including custom type interfaces, type wrapping, and unsafe memory operations.

classes.name: Type
classes.description: Interface representing a generic type with methods for type introspection and manipulation.

classes.name: ListType
classes.description: Interface extending Type for list-like types with element access and modification.

classes.name: ArrayType
classes.description: Interface for array types, extending ListType with length information.

classes.name: SliceType
classes.description: Interface for slice types with methods for making, growing, appending, and querying slices.

classes.name: StructType
classes.description: Interface for struct types with methods to access fields.

classes.name: StructField
classes.description: Interface representing a struct field with metadata and access methods.

classes.name: MapType
classes.description: Interface for map types with key/value access and iteration.

classes.name: MapIterator
classes.description: Interface for iterating over map entries.

classes.name: PtrType
classes.description: Interface for pointer types, providing access to the element type.

classes.name: InterfaceType
classes.description: Interface for interface types, providing method count.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Configuration struct for safe or unsafe type implementations.

classes.name: API
classes.description: Interface providing methods to obtain type information from objects or reflect types.

classes.name: frozenConfig
classes.description: Internal struct for cached, thread-safe configuration of type wrapping.

methods.name: Froze
methods.description: Creates a thread-safe, cached version of Config.

methods.name: TypeOf
methods.description: Returns the Type interface for a given object.

methods.name: Type2
methods.description: Returns the Type interface for a given reflect.Type.

methods.name: TypeOfPtr
methods.description: Returns the PtrType interface for a given object.

methods.name: PtrTo
methods.description: Returns the pointer type of a given Type.

methods.name: PtrOf
methods.description: Returns the unsafe.Pointer to the data of an object.

methods.name: RTypeOf
methods.description: Returns the reflect.Type uintptr of an object.

methods.name: IsNil
methods.description: Checks if an object is nil.

methods.name: IsNullable
methods.description: Checks if a reflect.Kind is nullable.

methods.name: likePtrKind
methods.description: Checks if a reflect.Kind is pointer-like.

methods.name: likePtrType
methods.description: Recursively checks if a reflect.Type is pointer-like.

methods.name: NoEscape
methods.description: Hides a pointer from escape analysis.

methods.name: UnsafeCastString
methods.description: Converts a string to a byte slice without copying, using unsafe operations.
